svg.desc: Forward and backward stages of a remote expert route over InfiniBand and NVLink.

g.text: B300 study · 32 × 16 GPUs · 1,048,576 tokens per sequence · training batch open

g.text: 0–2: MLA + dense FFN · 3–60: MLA + one shared expert and 8 of 256 routed experts
Loss gradient → head → blocks 60 to 0 → embedding. Parameter gradients feed the optimizer.
InfiniBand connects the nodes. A gateway GPU relays the tile over NVLink to the expert GPU; the result follows the reverse path.
Send activation to the expert node
Source GPU → remote gateway · token row x
Relay x to the expert owner
Gateway → expert GPU · input tile becomes ready
Expert GPU · x × Wgate and x × Wup
Expert GPU · SwiGLU followed by Wdown
Gateway → source node · ready for weighted sum
During the first gold interval: IB carries tile 3, NVLink relays tile 2, and compute uses tile 1.
Source GPU → remote gateway · weighted dY
Gateway → expert GPU · saved forward route
Expert GPU · produce the hidden-state gradient
Saved hidden rows and incoming dY → dWdown
SwiGLU derivative and gate/up weights → dX
Expert GPU → gateway · one contribution to dX
Send dX back to its origin
Gateway → source node · sum by original token
Saved inputs and activation derivatives → dWgate, dWup
During the first gold interval: IB carries tile 3, NVLink relays tile 2, and compute uses tile 1.
Read a number down the rows to follow that tile. Vertically aligned bars on different resources can overlap.
Unit ticks show dependencies. Isolated B300 probes available: none. Pending: compute, ib, nvlink.
